description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of parameter counts across five different fine-tuning designs, labeled “Increasing,” “Uniform,” “Decreasing,” “Spindle,” and “Bottleneck” along the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis represents the design type, with categories arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Parameter Count,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each design is represented by five gray bars. In the “Increasing” design, the bar heights progress from approximately 1 to 8. The “Uniform” design features five bars of equal height, each reaching approximately 6. The “Decreasing” design shows bar heights decreasing from approximately 9 to 2. The “Spindle” design has bars with heights of approximately 2, 4, 7, 4, and 2. Finally, the “Bottleneck” design displays bars with heights of approximately 2, 2, 8, 2, and 2. No bars are visually emphasized or sorted beyond the alphabetical order of the design labels.
